items.summary: The Bay Area Reporter reported that Tam would ask the chancellor and vice chancellor of finance to expand multi-year projections from three years to five.
items.title: Ask for five-year budget projections

citations.quote: He would ask the chancellor and vice chancellor of finance and administration to expand the multi-year projections from three years to five in order to allow for adequate planning.

items.summary: The Guardsman reported that Tam wants to empower the Participatory Governance Council to collaborate on a financial plan.
items.title: Have the Participatory Governance Council collaborate on a financial plan

citations.quote: Tam wants to raise awareness about the details of City College’s multiyear projection and empower the Participatory Governance Council to collaborate on a financial plan.

items.summary: The Guardsman reported that Tam hopes to strengthen Free City and dual enrollment by re-establishing a joint committee of the trustees, the SFUSD board and the Board of Supervisors.
items.title: Re-establish the joint committee with SFUSD and the Board of Supervisors

citations.quote: re-establishing the joint committee between the Board of Trustees, the San Francisco Unified School District’s board of education, and the city’s board of supervisors

items.summary: The Guardsman reported that Tam does not support selling the Downtown Center.
items.title: Keep the Downtown Center rather than sell it

citations.quote: He does not support selling the Downtown Center
